create_agent: create an Option Keyboard Agent with policy weights, epsilon greedy exploration, and a DQN replay buffer
build_option_valuenet: build an OptionValueNet Sonnet module that outputs Q-values for multiple policies and actions
run_agent_step: run an epsilon-greedy action selection step for the current policy given an environment timestep
update_agent_replay: update the agent by appending a transition to the replay buffer and training when batch is full
export_agent_keyboard: export the trained keyboard network to a TF Hub directory and save checkpoint weights
